title: vacation
text:
On a vacation with close friends, chilling at the beach, far in the water. We eventually saw something camoed into the horizon, it then decloaked itself. A lanky, pure dark figure was waving at us, smiling.

We were weirded out so we headed on back to the shore where we found a small spool of paper rolled up. When the paper unspooled it gave directions to go back out into the water. Where there were now a couple more dark figures.

One of my close friends, without hesitation, went worward and before they could do anything, was torn in half and turned into one of these figures in the process.

The figures started made their way calmly to us as we fled, slowly being picked off one by one.

Yeah thats how it ended, that was the whole dream.
